title: Q3 2026 All-Hands: announce + talking points (draft)
content:
Purpose:
- Draft announcement and host talking points for Redwood All-Hands (Q3 2026). Aim: share company priorities for the quarter, celebrate wins, set expectations, and surface Q&A.

Quick logistics (working):
- Date/Time: Tue Jul 28, 2026, 10:00–11:15 PT (proposed)
- Format: 10 min company update, 20 min product/engineering demo, 15 min customer & GTM update, 15 min roadmap + metrics, 15 min leadership Q&A, 10 min shoutouts
- Venue: Zoom (recorded), livestream to offices, captions on.
- RSVP: RSVP form link (embed in final doc).

Draft announcement email (short):
Subject: All-Hands — Q3 priorities, product demos, and a few wins (Jul 28)
Hi team,

Hope you’re all doing well — we’re planning our Q3 All-Hands on Tue Jul 28 at 10:00 PT. We’ll share a short update on business and product priorities, demo a couple of things shipping this quarter, and leave time for questions. Please block the time if you can; recording will be available.

High-level highlights we’ll cover:
- Customer momentum: a few new Dedicated contracts and pilot wins in regulated industries.
- Product: Redwood Optimize v1 improvements and a new rollout for Private deployments.
- Reliability: steady latency SLOs, one notable incident postmortem we’ll summarize and actions taken.

If you have questions you want raised live, drop them in #all-hands-thread or submit anonymously here (link).

See you then — Maria (on behalf of People Ops)

Notes for host / opening remarks:
- Quick welcome, call out remote-first attendance, thank new hires (list to pull from HR).
- Remind of our mission: making reliable, economical inference accessible — tie Q3 work to that.
- Acknowledge recent wins and hiring momentum.

Company highlights (talking points):
- Business: 
  - Usage growth: month-over-month API consumption +18% (topline ask: confirm final numbers with Finance).
  - New contracts: 2 Dedicated deals closed (mid-market + regulated healthcare pilot).
  - ARR health: on track vs plan (TBD; Ethan to confirm numbers).

- Product & Engineering: 
  - Redwood Optimize: early access rollout expanded to 20 customers; initial cost reductions reported (~25% avg token cost down for batch-heavy workloads).
  - Private deployments: shipping automated KMS integration and improved rollout docs — reduces onboarding friction for enterprise pilots.
  - Serving runtime: kernel selection improvements reduced 95p latency by ~12% for long-sequence workloads. (Samira to present demo)

- Reliability & SRE:
  - Incident recap: June outage — brief cause summary (capacity autoscaler bug + fallback misrouting), mitigations implemented (hotfix + improved testing), and action items (more load tests + DR runbook updates).

- GTM / Customer Success:
  - Highlight a reference customer story (generic safe summary) showing cost savings and predictable latency after moving to Dedicated.

Product demo plan (20 min):
- Samira: Redwood Optimize dashboard walkthrough (show before/after cost view, recommended config suggestions).
- Oliver: Private deployment KMS flow + onboarding checklist (short demo).

Roadmap / Q3 priorities (concise bullets):
- Expand Redwood Optimize recommendations + automated A/B rollback (measure quality regression risk).
- Improve autoscaler reliability and capacity forecasting for Dedicated.
- Faster model onboarding path: reduce person-hours to onboard a new open model by 30%.
- Observability: per-route token-level traces + long-tail error alerting.

Metrics to surface (confirm numbers ahead):
- MRR/ARR movement vs plan
- API token volume growth vs prior quarter
- 95p/99p latency trends (hosted + dedicated)
- Cost per 1M tokens (summary for hosted vs dedicated)
- Customer NPS / CSAT highlight (if available)

Shoutouts and hiring notes:
- Call out teams with big Q2 wins: Dedicated sales, SRE, Platform-engineering, People Ops for hiring ramp.
- Hiring: list top roles and ask managers to re-raise referral asks.

Anticipated Q&A (prepare concise answers):
1) "Are we pausing anything important to hit cost targets?"
   - Answer: No wholesale pauses. Priorities are focused optimizations (Optimize, autoscaler improvements) that reduce unit economics without cutting roadmap items that deliver customer value.
2) "What’s the plan for Private/on-prem roadmap vs Hosted?"
   - Answer: Maintain parity for core APIs, focus Private on enterprise needs (KMS/HSM, compliance), and continue to invest in Hosted performance and cost.
3) "Will there be layoffs or hiring freezes?"
   - Answer: No planned layoffs. We continue to prioritize hires in SRE, infra, and customer-facing roles; hiring levels are evaluated monthly.
4) "How are we measuring Redwood Optimize impact on quality?"
   - Answer: Every recommendation has expected cost/latency delta and an associated eval suite; early rollouts include automated quality checks and optional A/B rollback.
5) "Any immediate changes to pricing?"
   - Answer: No consumer-facing pricing changes this quarter; we’re focused on packaging and enterprise commitments for Dedicated.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Pull final numbers from Finance by Jul 22 (Ethan).
- Confirm demo readiness with Samira and Oliver by Jul 20.
- Collect hire names for shoutouts from HR.
- Draft Q&A answers with leadership: legal check on phrasing for customer references.
- Finalize RSVP & recording logistics with IT.

Style notes / tone guidance:
- Transparent but concise. Avoid overpromising; call out risks briefly (e.g., capacity constraints).
- Celebrate wins and attribute to teams.
- Keep product explanations accessible for non-engineering folks — avoid deep technical jargon in the main update; demos can include details.

Appendix: possible snippets to include in slide deck
- One-slide company health: topline numbers + 2 bullets on risk/momentum
- One-slide product wins: Optimize before/after, Private KMS onboarding time reduced
- One-slide SRE: incident summary + actions
- Closing slide: ways to ask Qs (Slack thread, anonymous form, live Q&A)

Draft end of announcement (to iterate):
Thanks — looking forward to seeing everyone on Jul 28. If you’d like to propose a short shoutout or customer highlight, ping me or add it to the shared doc (link).

— Maria
